comment: The CKEditor 5 Media embed plugin must be built against the same CKEditor 5
version Drupal core bundles, or the editor fails with
ckeditor-duplicated-modules. This module supports several core majors, which
bundle different CKEditor 5 versions, so it cannot pin the library itself.
Read core's version from web/core/core.libraries.yml (the ckeditor5: entry)
and require the matching tag in the project or recipe that pins the core
version. CKEditor 5 releases from 47.7.0 on are the Long Term Support
edition, which is commercial-licence only and must not be shipped in a
GPL-2.0-or-later distribution; 47.6.2 is the last GPL dual-licensed release
